# harness_platform_gitops_agent_dr_promotion (Resource)

Resource for promoting a Disaster Recovery secondary GitOps agent node to primary. Deleting this resource is a no-op; change `triggers` to repeat a promotion.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harness_platform_gitops_agent_dr_promotion" "example" {
  org_id               = "org_id"
  project_id           = "project_id"
  agent_id             = "agent_id"
  dr_identifier        = "dr_identifier"
  disable_sync_windows = false

  triggers = {
    promoted_at = "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Identifier of the GitOps agent to promote.
- `dr_identifier` (String) Disaster Recovery identifier to promote to PRIMARY.

### Optional

- `disable_sync_windows` (Boolean) Disable sync windows for the new primary agent.
- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier of the GitOps agent.
- `project_id` (String) Project identifier of the GitOps agent.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `triggers` (Map of String) Map of arbitrary string values. Any change to this map forces replacement of the resource, causing the promotion to be repeated.

### Read-Only

- `current_primary` (String) The dr_identifier of the DR node currently reported as PRIMARY by the server.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
